message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP, so:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \approx £15.60
\]

So you would expect roughly **£15.5–£16** for $20, but check a reliable financial source or your bank for the exact rate at the time of your transaction.
